The '''Alsakan Lowlands''' was a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that lay east of the [[Apalis Coast]] and west of the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] and [[King's Pass]]. A relatively flat region along the coastline, the Lowlands were home to [[Fort Orrus]] and the [[House Teral (estate)|estate]] of [[House Teral]], as well as the [[House Baliss (estate)|estate]] of [[House Teraan]], but [[House Baliss]] ousted the Teraans and took over the estate as their own during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. [[Wardpost Duvaal]] was located in the [[Serene Meadow]], the name given to the eastern section of the region, and the [[Mensaav Military Laboratory]] was built into the mountainside north of the meadow and House Teral. The [[Frostflower Path]] ran along the coastline, linking the area to the Apalis Coast to the west.
